_comment: Anthropic API list prices in USD per million tokens, keyed by model ID. Checked against platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing and .../models/overview on 21 October 2026. Re-verify before relying on them; unlisted models are treated as unpriced and paid calls to them are blocked.

claude-haiku-5-5.notes: Rates for prompts over 100k tokens are five times higher. Tokenizer yields about 30 percent more tokens than Haiku 4.5. Thinking tokens count toward max_tokens.

claude-haiku-4-5-20251001.notes: Price is the Haiku 4.5 row. The dated ID is the repository's existing value; it is not printed on the pricing or models pages, so confirm it with the Models API.
